surface_detection.note: ui/handlers.js, ui/renderer.js, ui/runner-bridge.js are Tauri WebView frontend files but do not match the gate_plan.ui_globs (which exclude plain .js and root-level ui/ paths). They are user-visible surfaces by project context even though they fall outside the configured globs.

checked: @playwright/test in package.json dependencies — not present (only referenced in an old task's test:ui script)
cypress in package.json dependencies — not present

dynamic_playwright_feasibility.reason: This is a Tauri desktop app. The WebView that renders ui/handlers.js, ui/renderer.js, and ui/runner-bridge.js is a native macOS WKWebView embedded in a compiled binary. Playwright targets HTTP-served web pages or Electron apps via CDP; it cannot attach to a Tauri WKWebView without tauri-driver (WebDriver protocol bridge). tauri-driver is not present in this project (no webdriver.json, no tauri-driver binary, no wdio.conf.js). Installing @playwright/test alone would produce no automatable target.

remediation: Option A (recommended for this ticket): rely on the manual DoD smoke steps already defined in the plan. The changed surfaces (correlation-id propagation through PTY IPC) are not visually diffable — they require PTY session observation or log inspection, which is better suited to manual or integration-level testing.
Option B (future): configure tauri-driver + WebDriverIO for Tauri-native e2e automation (https://tauri.app/v1/guides/testing/webdriver/). This is a project-level investment, not per-ticket work.
Option C (future): update gate_plan.ui_globs to include ui/**/*.js so the surface is correctly flagged in future runs.
